postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()) == sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i+N+1].split()[0]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()), 2+N)) for stdout in [stdout])
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the total number of queries across all test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) <= 99 for i in range(len(stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer representing the minimum absolute difference between distinct node values on the path between query nodes.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda S: min(abs(A[x-1] - A[y-1]) for x in S for y in S if x != y))(get_path(a, b)) == int(stdout.splitlines()[i]) for i, (a, b) in enumerate(get_queries()))
postconditions.description: For each query (a, b), the output is the minimum absolute difference between any two distinct node values on the simple path S between a and b. Here, A is the list of node values, and get_path(a, b) returns the set of nodes on the path between a and b (inclusive).
